Users.description: Paths of the authentication related pages, relative to the tenant base path. Leading and trailing '/' characters are ignored. See https://docs.orchardcore.net/en/latest/reference/modules/Users/.

LoginPath.description: The path of the login page.

LogoffPath.description: The path used to log off.

ChangePasswordUrl.description: The path of the change password page.

ChangePasswordConfirmationUrl.description: The path of the page displayed after the password is changed.

ExternalLoginsUrl.description: The path of the page used to manage the external logins of the current user.

TwoFactorAuthenticationPath.description: The path of the two-factor authentication page.

OrchardCore_Users.deprecationMessage: The 'OrchardCore_Users' section is deprecated. Use 'OrchardCore:Users' instead.
